name: ui-product-suite
title: Product UI suite (plan Part 2), consecutive runs (flakiness check)

git.commit_note: branch main has no commits yet; numbers come from the uncommitted working tree

environment.docker_desktop_note: Docker Desktop on Windows: containers run in the WSL2 VM; Redis/Postgres/Qdrant and sandboxes cross the Windows<->VM boundary

conditions.what: tests/playwright ui-*.spec.ts: Chromium on the real pages (/, /rooms, /room/[id]) of a NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E=1 build (test auth swapped in at build time)
conditions.topology: 2 sync nodes + Node LB, API (NODE_ENV=test, CORS), AI service (LLM_PROVIDER=mock_scenario), worker with the hardened Docker sandbox

protocol: suite run back to back; no warm-up (pass/fail check)
